findings.evidence: All ingredients are `n`-polymorphic: `ContinuousLinearEquiv.contDiff` (Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/ContDiff/Basic.lean:165, with `{m n : ℕ∞ω}` at line 32), `ModelWithCorners.contMDiff` (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/ContMDiff/Atlas.lean:50), `ModelWithCorners.contMDiffOn_symm` (Atlas.lean:58), `ContMDiffOn.comp_contMDiff` (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/ContMDiff/Basic.lean:142, no `IsManifold` hypothesis), and `IsManifold I n H` for a model space at every `n` (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/Basic.lean:808). Mathlib states its own product diffeomorphisms polymorphically (`Diffeomorph.prodCongr` line 536, `prodComm` line 558); grep for `of_le`/`mono` in Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Diffeomorph.lean returns no regularity-lowering lemma for `Diffeomorph`.
findings.fix: Add `{k : WithTop ℕ∞}` (or an explicit `(k : ℕ∞ω)`) and state `Diffeomorph ((𝓡 n).prod (𝓡∂ 1)) (𝓡∂ (n + 1)) _ _ k`, propagating `k` through `collarDiffeomorph_apply_zero`, `_apply_succ`, `_symm_apply_fst`, `_symm_apply_snd_apply_zero`, `_apply_zero_normal` and `collarDiffeomorph_toHomeomorph`. The proof body should go through verbatim.
findings.issue: `collarDiffeomorph` is pinned to `∞`, but the map is a linear coordinate permutation and the whole proof is polymorphic in the regularity index; the rest of `Boundary/` is stated at a variable `k` (`Charts.lean:78`, `{k : WithTop ℕ∞}`; `isManifold_boundary`/`isImmersion_subtypeVal_boundary` at level `k`). Mathlib has no `Diffeomorph.of_le`, and `ω` is above `∞`, so neither the analytic case nor a bundled `C^k` collar is recoverable from this statement — the global collar theorem this PR exists to feed cannot be stated at the same `k` as the boundary-manifold results it builds on.

summary: The construction is at the right level except that `collarDiffeomorph` fixes the smoothness index to `∞` although its proof is regularity-polymorphic and the surrounding boundary API is stated for a variable `k`.
